one_minute_value_explanation: AOF can now take a session contract about a agent session evidence chain, replay the evidence path, update confidence explicitly, and route uncertainty to governance instead of hiding it.
thirty_second_version_delta: v11.2 made a GitHub session log governed and auditable; v11.4 makes session contract of that read replayable and confidence-aware.
product_review_trigger: If the operator still cannot tell whether session contract strengthened, weakened, blocked, or escalated a session-evidence claim, reopen session contract recognition design.
not_proven: This does not prove provider semantic truth, actual independent third-party validation, GitHub write safety, credential safety, production automation, market value, productivity gain, or broad adoption.
